title: console: a formula field whose `returnType` is currency renders as money (the consumer of objectstack's formula currency result)
body:
Filing gate ①: the console half of finding B-15. Filed by the triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`), splitting objectstack-ai/objectstack#22722 (the maintainer's HotCRM browser pass, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2058, measured on `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Restart when:** a published `@objectstack/spec` release that objectui installs carries the formula currency result (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22727).

## Read on objectui `main` `ce991bd70f`

`packages/fields/src/index.tsx` `FormulaCellRenderer` (about `:2672`–`:2705`) sends every numeric formula to `NumberCellRenderer`.

## Done when

- A formula declared with the currency result renders through the currency renderer, in cells, forms and detail.
- Pins:
  - a currency formula renders as money;
  - CONTROL: a numeric formula renders as today.

`domain:ui` · p3.
